title: The Shot Nobody Reported
surface: I sit and watch a familiar-looking person draw a gun; someone else falls. Many people around me see it, but nobody calls the police. I stay seated too. Much later the lights come on and we leave. Nobody is conspiring or frozen with fear. Why?
solution: We are watching a movie in a cinema. The familiar face belongs to an actor I recognize from other films, not a personal acquaintance. The shot and collapse are fictional events on the screen. When the movie ends, the auditorium lights come on and the audience leaves.

facts.text: The group is watching fictional events on a cinema screen.
The familiar face is an actor and the lights signal the film’s end, so no police response is needed.
There is no real shooting or injury in the auditorium.

unknowns: The film, actor and seats are unspecified.
hints: Recognizing a face does not mean knowing the person personally.
Why is everyone seated and waiting for the lights?
The scene takes place during a cinema screening.
